instructions: Take the almond milk out of the fridge first. Cold milk makes the coconut oil go solid in lumps.
Heat the oven to 350°F. Rub 1 tsp of the coconut oil around the inside of an 8 by 8 inch baking dish.
Melt 1/4 cup coconut oil in a small bowl in the microwave, 30 to 60 seconds.
Mash the banana in a large bowl with a fork until it's smooth, with only small lumps left.
Add 1 cup almond milk, 1/4 cup almond butter, 1/4 cup maple syrup and the melted coconut oil, and whisk until smooth. Whisk in the 1 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp cinnamon and 1/2 tsp salt.
Roughly chop 1 cup of the pecans. Fold the 2 cups oats, 3/4 cup of the chopped pecans and 1/2 cup of the blueberries into the bowl, then spread it evenly in the dish.
Scatter the remaining 1/2 cup blueberries and 1/4 cup pecans over the top, then the 2 tbsp brown sugar and 2 tbsp coconut flakes.
Bake for 40 to 50 minutes, until the top is golden and crisp and the middle doesn't wobble when you shake the dish.
Let it cool for 10 minutes, then cut it into 4 squares and serve it warm. Any squares you don't eat keep covered in the fridge for up to 4 days. Reheat one in the microwave for about 1 minute.
method_notes: Both stir oats into a sweetened, cinnamon spiced milk base with baking powder, fold in blueberries and nuts, and bake until the middle is set. Love and Lemons (the lead) is vegan: mashed banana, almond milk, almond butter, maple syrup and coconut oil in an 8 by 8 dish at 350°F, with extra berries, pecans, brown sugar and coconut on top for a crisp crust. Well Plated binds it with eggs and applesauce instead, uses milk and butter, toasts the almonds first and bakes it at 375°F. This one follows the lead's pan and ratios, which give four hearty squares.
